newsitem.title: USA: IMF, Ecuador make progress in loan talks.
newsitem.headline: IMF, Ecuador make progress in loan talks.

text.p: The International Monetary Fund has made progress in talks on a new loan for Ecuador and discussions are likely to resume in October, an international monetary source said on Thursday.
"There is optimism. Not all the issues have been resolved, but there was considerable progress towards a program," the source said after an IMF team completed its regular review of Ecuador's econony.
Ecuadorean officials said in March that Quito was looking for a standby arrangement with the IMF but gave no figures for the size of a loan.
A previous program worth a total of 173 million Special Drawing Rights (now worth $235 million) was halted at the government's request in December 1995.
Ministers said last month they would not be able to meet a budget deficit target of 2.7 percent of gross domestic product, as bad weather and salary increases would boost government spending.
